Diet/foraging percentage zero is explicit source evidence, not absent-claim completion.
Related thresholds and diet components retain shared evidence groups.
Upstream reference families grouped from publisher metadata/source index; original books not independently checked.
Body-mass thresholds are species adult means and may be difficult for humans to answer.
Opposing family negatives derive only from explicit functional family assignments within the same taxonomy version; missing claims stay unknown.
